name: browser-spotlight
title: Browser Spotlight
description: Arc-style Command Bar for the frontmost Chromium/WebKit browser: jump to open tabs, search the web, site-scoped search, and extensions.
author: johann_goncalves_pereira

commands.name: search

commands.description: Search open tabs, the web, sites, and extensions in the frontmost browser.
